purpose: Independent station observations for regional ERA5-Land quality comparison. Station-day comparisons are diagnostic only; no automatic bias correction or climate activation.

source.portalNotes: Daily observations can be selected by station, element and period and exported as CSV. Preserve quality/homogeneity flags; missing values must remain null. The portal notes request-size limits and advises against excessive automated access.
